verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own marketing says users can pick any model through OpenRouter or bring their own Claude/Codex subscriptions, so choosing a specific model is a documented capability. However, the evidence never mentions an automatic model-selection mode to switch away from, and it does not show how or where the choice is made. Missing for 10: evidence of an automatic/default model-selection mode and an override control, documentation of per-task or per-team model selection settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: Bring your own API keys or existing Codex and Claude subscriptions, or pick any model through OpenRouter.
Code locally in Claude, remotely via codex, or launch our agents in the cloud.
